traceability.notes:
The story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are unchanged from the previous assessment. The current implementation provides an ESLint rule traceability/require-branch-annotation that: - Detects significant branches (if/else, try/catch, switch cases, loops) and enforces presence of @story and @req annotations (REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION). - Correctly associates comments with branches, including special handling for SwitchCase and CatchClause, with dedicated tests (REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING). - Parses annotations via regex-based helpers and reports missing ones with a clear, specific message (REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, User Experience). - Defines significance via DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES while allowing a configurable branchTypes option and robustly reporting invalid configuration (REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE). - Handles nested and complex control flow structures, with tests explicitly targeting nested branches and catch-specific positioning (Integration, Error Handling). - Has been performance-tested on large files with many nested branches (REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, Quality Standards) and passes within the specified budget. - Is documented in docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md with usage, configuration, and examples, and is integrated into the plugin’s recommended and strict configs.
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied and verified by passing automated tests and documentation, so the story is fully implemented.
